Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 의뢰를 성공적으로 수행한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(이)가 사후 평가를 준비한다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After a successful quest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> began preparing her debriefing.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼を成し遂げた<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>が事後評価の準備をする。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 成功执行委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>准备进行事后评价。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 成功執行委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>準備進行事後評價。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a terminé la quête avec succès et se prépare pour le débriefing.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hat den Auftrag erfolgreich abgeschlossen und bereitet die Nachbesprechung vor.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ha completado la misión con éxito y se prepara para el informe final.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> concluiu a missão com sucesso e se prepara para a avaliação pós-missão.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ที่ทำภารกิจสำเร็จแล้ว เตรียมพร้อมสำหรับการประเมินผลหลังภารกิจ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah berhasil menyelesaikan misi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mulai mempersiapkan evaluasi pascamisi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã hoàn thành nhiệm vụ thành công và đang chuẩn bị cho buổi đánh giá sau nhiệm vụ.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: एक सफल मिशन के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने अपनी मिशन समीक्षा की तैयारी शुरू कर दी।
